subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter-group will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

78, 97, 54, ?, 30, 145
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

There are two series in the given series:

Series 1: 78 - 24 = 54; 54 - 24 = 30 ; 

Series 2: **97 + 24 = 121**; 121 + 24 = 145.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/559f3bab863ec21e550f2efd7bfab32e2723705b977a35c108827f9dc185687e.png] 

Hence,** "121"** is the correct answer.
